snippet.title: City States: Medieval | 1.0 Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
One city against a world of empires. City States: Medieval is out now in full 1.0.
Play now on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4066390/City_States_Medieval/

Lead a medieval merchant republic through the 12th century. Build a thriving city, chart trade routes across the known world for twelve precious commodities and defend your wealth with an all-new siege system that blends real-time tactical combat with tower defense. Every neighboring kingdom is larger than you, so survival means outsmarting them all.

If you love strategy, city builders and grand-scale trade, your next campaign is here.

Get it on the indie.io store ➤ https://store.indie.io/city-states-medieval 
Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
